column1: # Psy-Q SDK data tables inside SLUS_006.62 (address ranges ONLY -- no bytes).
# Consumed by tools/analysis/psyq_port_guard.py, which reads the bytes from the
# user's own retail EXE at check time and fails if the port or its tests embed
# them.  Evidence: build/lanes/psyq/PLAN.md section "Psy-Q data tables".
#   * SQRT / rcossin_tbl / ratan_tbl: byte-identical (192 / 8192 / 1025 int16)
#     to the libgte tables shipped by PsyCross src/gte/{sqrt,rcossin,ratan}_tbl.h.
#   * rsin_tbl (1025 int16 quarter-wave sin*4096) and the 192-entry reciprocal
#     sqrt table sit in the same libgte .data block (0x8009589C..0x8009AEEE),
#     next to libgte's "Can't push matrix" PushMatrix error strings.
name
libgte_rsin_tbl
libgte_SQRT
libgte_rsqrt_tbl
libgte_rcossin_tbl
libgte_ratan_tbl
# NOT scanned: the libcd command-class tables (6 x 32 u32 of 0/1 flags at
# 0x8009B07C/B0FC/B17C/B1FC/B5A4/B624) are too low-entropy for a byte/literal
# scan (false positives everywhere). Known embedder: tests/retail_cd_device_tables.h
# (manual finding, build/lanes/psyq/test_data_audit.tsv).
# libpress DecDCT tables in PE.IMG ovl_039F (vram 0x8010BCF8): the MDEC quant
# command block (MPEG-1 default intra matrix) and the IDCT scale block.
libpress_quant_block
libpress_scale_block
